notes.title: Just VR Slingshot Target Practice is now available!
notes.notes:
We finally released Just VR Slingshot Target Practice! Are you excited to shoot some targets? [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/586990/]Buy it now![/url]

Perhaps there's something more interesting hidden behind those targets... Will you be able to unlock the secret?


Thanks everyone, we hope you enjoy the game! See you on the leaderboards!
